hero.headline: Making sense of complexity through human-centred design.
body: Senior Service Designer & CX Strategist shaping the future of customer experience, service design, and product innovation.
Over the past 5 years at AKQA, I've partnered with leading brands across banking, superannuation, retail, and government to design services that work — for people and for business.
I translate deep human insight into clear strategy, tangible experiences, and scalable service solutions that drive growth, loyalty, and real-world impact.
